title: CLO3D VS MARVELOUS AS PATTERN MAKER
content:
Hello guys, I learnt Clo3d recently, my purpose is to use it as a pattern maker for garment production. I have some difficulties by exporting file as PLT for printing. Sometime the file is expanding or reducing its size for the same setting on my printer? ( to solve this problem, i used to export my file as DFX to transfer it in Gerber to export again as PLT file) I'm wondering if anyone has a trick for this problem or I should try Marvelous program instead

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi, CLO is optimized for the fashion industry, MD is geared towards the gaming and animation sector. Several patternmaking options are not available in MD. So CLO is the more fitting solution for your needs. Concerning the issue you are facing, it would be best to contact tech support. Please include an example projected file and an exported PLT that shows the problem: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/3bbb0c18bf0c44ba8e02c8992ecfc6fc
content_description: A community forum page to share tips and solutions for exporting accurate PLT files from Clo3D for garment pattern printing.
